usb.baud.hint: Safe on all chips: 115200 / 230400 / 460800. Fast (most ESP32 + ESP8266 with stub): 921600. ESP8266 may fail >921600. >1500000 only reliable on ESP32-S3 / C3 / C6 with native USB-CDC. Drop to 9600 / 57600 for long or noisy cables and flaky USB-UART adapters.

ip.resolved_public: ⚠ {ip} (indirizz PUBBLIKU - dan MHUX l-ESP tiegħek fuq il-LAN!)
ip.warn_public: Twissija: {host} jiġi solvut għal IP pubbliku {ip}. Aktarx MHUX l-ESP tiegħek - iċċekkja jekk qed tuża TLD pubbliku (.world, .com eċċ.). Aħjar uża isem mDNS (eż. hello.local) jew direttament l-indirizz LAN (192.168.x.x).

flash.tool_missing: Għodda meħtieġa mhux misjuba: {tool}. Installa bi: pip install {package}
flash.ota_stub: Il-flash OTA tal-fajls .bin jeħtieġ l-għodda espota.py (inkluża fil-pakkett esphome).
flash.hint.dialout: Pariri: 'Permission denied' fuq il-port serjali normalment ifisser li l-utent tiegħek MHUX fil-grupp 'dialout'. Soluzzjoni: sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER, imbagħad OĦROĠ u erġa' idħol. Ikklikkja 'Iċċekkja l-għodod' biex tikkonferma.
flash.hint.crash_detected: Crash misjub fuq l-apparat. Uża 'Iddekodja stack trace...' hawn taħt biex tirsolvi l-indirizzi kontra firmware.elf kompilat lokalment.
flash.hint.decode_no_elf: Suġġeriment: stack trace ma ġiex dekodjat awtomatikament - normalment minħabba li ma hemmx firmware.elf lokali li jaqbel. Ħaddem l-ewwel Compile (jew Run), imbagħad Logs mill-ġdid għal simboli dekodjati.
flash.hint.long_op: Suġġeriment: komponent imblokka l-loop ewlieni. Każijiet serji jikkawżaw reset tal-watchdog jew skonnessjonijiet tal-Wi-Fi. Ara https://esphome.io/guides/troubleshooting/#performance-troubleshooting
flash.hint.logger_verbose: Twissija: il-livell tal-logger VERY_VERBOSE jista' jnaqqas l-apparat b'mod sinifikanti. Uża biss għal sessjonijiet qosra ta' debugging.

actions.reset.desc: Hard-reset the connected ESP via DTR/RTS (USB only).

tabs.erase.title: Erase flash
erase.warning_body: This wipes the entire SPI flash on the connected ESP. Use it to rescue "bricked" modules that no longer boot or accept new firmware.
erase.consequences: After erase: the device will not boot until you flash firmware again. All saved Wi-Fi credentials, calibration data, NVS, and any user partitions are gone.
erase.confirm: I understand this will erase the flash on the connected device and cannot be undone.
erase.button.desc: Run `esptool erase-flash` on the selected USB device (requires confirmation above).
erase.usb_only: Erase flash requires USB mode (cannot wipe a remote OTA device).
